news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹197 (vs ₹7.34 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹197 (up from ₹7.34 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹1.75b (up 497% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹403.0m (up ₹388.4m from FY 2025). Profit margin: 23% (up from 4.9% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 129% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 180% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹5.32 (vs ₹3.16 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹5.32 (up from ₹3.16 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹162.4m (up 184% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹143.7m (up ₹137.5m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 89% (up from 11% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was primarily driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 54% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 140% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Onix Solar Energy Limited Approves Appointment of Piyush Mansukhbhai Savalia as Managing Director
news.body: Onix Solar Energy Limited at its board meeting held on 16 January, 2026 approved appointment of Mr. Piyush Mansukhbhai Savalia as Managing Director of the company.

news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 4 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 4 new directors. No experienced directors. No highly experienced directors. Independent Non-Executive Chairman Yesha Shah is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2024. The company’s lack of experienced directors is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹3.82 loss per share (vs ₹0.75 profit in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: ₹3.82 loss per share (down from ₹0.75 profit in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹434.8m (up ₹433.5m from 2Q 2025). Net loss: ₹7.55m (down ₹9.04m from profit in 2Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 19% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 63% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
